Government Coal Gasification Scheme Receives No Applications

A Rs 37,500-crore government scheme aimed at promoting coal and lignite gasification has reportedly received no applications. This lack of interest has raised concerns about the viability of the projects. However, the Coal Ministry has rejected claims that there are "no takers," stating that NTPC and Talcher Fertilisers have already applied for the scheme.
